# Billing Discussion
Date: 2026-09-22 | Duration: 28.65999984741211m

## Summary
The team completed a year of manual and AI-assisted contract cleanup, led by Jeff Ignacio using Claude, with about 10 contracts missed. The work added contract dates and billing terms and established a foundation for reliable revenue tracking. Because reporting currently lags 60–80 days, Mark Beltran requested monthly updates and a target of under 30 days. New order forms and mandatory HubSpot fields will capture start and end dates, billing contacts, tax information, and other billing details before deals close, using dropdowns where possible. Jeff will map the fields, document the process, and coordinate automation with Jennifer Pham-Le so deal closures trigger invoicing notifications in a shared Slack channel. Jennifer plans to move invoicing from Stripe to ORB, while QuickBooks integration remains pending. The team also identified the need for automated AR aging reports, overdue-payment sequences, and a formal commission reporting process. Ryan McGurk will help train sales, and Cary Rakin will support collections messaging and automation. CPQ adoption was deferred until sales scale increases.

## Keywords
billing automation, HubSpot integration, revenue operations, AR aging report, order form, commission process

## Action Items

**Jeff Ignacio**
Add missing HubSpot fields including billing contact and tailor fields mapped from order forms to improve billing accuracy and data completeness (23:24)
Assemble the formal commission cadence/process and distribute commission statements for rep review and approval to ensure accurate and timely commission payments (22:45)
Document the new sales and billing processes and coordinate training sessions and office hours for the sales team to ensure compliance with updated procedures (26:01)
Support mapping out finance and sales operational processes to ensure smooth ERP integration in the future (10:24)
Create and facilitate a shared Slack channel for billing requests notifications to improve communication and backup coverage (15:38)

**Ryan McGurk**
Review HubSpot field setup with Jeff Ignacio and lead training on new order form and mandatory field completion to ensure accurate data capture (23:43)
Begin rollout and enforcement of new order forms with billing fields for all sales reps immediately to standardize contract data capture (05:44)
Provide Jeff Ignacio the new order form for field mapping to HubSpot to align data capture and billing processes (24:21)

**Jennifer Pham-Le**
Test and finalize transition from Stripe to ORB for invoicing to improve billing efficiency and integration capabilities (11:21)
Pull and review Stripe report monthly to identify overdue invoices and support collections efforts (21:14)
Confirm preferred process for receiving billing notifications (Slack channel) and participate in setting up billing requests workflow to streamline communication (15:38)
Provide commission data to Jeff Ignacio and support setup of a formal commission review process to ensure accuracy and transparency (22:45)
Continue current billing and collection activities while new automations are implemented to maintain cash flow (26:20)

**Cary Rakin**
Help build automated AR aging and collection sequences in HubSpot or Apollo, including tailored outreach templates to improve collections efficiency (20:03)
Advise on adding tax deductible and billing address fields for nonprofit and invoice accuracy in HubSpot to enhance record keeping (24:14)

**Mark Beltran**
Provide input on data and process requirements for collection cycles compression and reporting cadence to improve cash flow management (02:54)

**Andy Marshall**
Assist in defining custom MSA status tracking in HubSpot fields to improve contract management visibility (24:38)
